items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: Yeah we worked with him Oh yes We did have a piano player on that record record with Sam Walter Beck made that record with Sam

ctx.x: And what about Walter Beck? Did you ever work with him?

Yeah we worked with him Oh yes We did have a piano player on that record record with Sam Walter Beck made that record with Sam Oh yeah? Yeah that's right He made that record with Sam I don't want to take his right spot and he did me in the recording Sam With Sam The piano, Walter Beck would remember that good At the same time Walter He wanted the piano player and Walter was He was coming up, coming up Biller Street And named Sam was standing on the corner of Biller and Demain And we see Walter come I said Sam…
Who was the regular banjo player with Sam on it? Johnny Deade He was with him for years?
